steps.name: Baseline
steps.do: Confirm every **Include …** Explore toggle is unchecked (**Include off display animals**, **Include closed restaurants**, **Include closed restrooms**, **Include closed gift shops**, **Include closed attractions**). Note which markers are on the map.
steps.expect: Those toggles are all off, and you have a clear before-picture of visible markers for later comparison.

steps.name: Midwinter without off-display animals
steps.do: Set Specific Map to a midwinter weekday. Keep **Animals** checked in **Filter:**. Search **Warthog** (or **River Hippopotamus**).
steps.expect: That animal is not on the map while **Include off display animals** is off.

steps.name: Include off display animals on
steps.do: Enable **Include off display animals**, then search **Warthog** (or **River Hippopotamus**) again and **View on Map**.

steps.name: Off-display feedback
steps.do: Open that animal’s click tooltip (and any banner on the marker).

steps.name: Include closed restaurants
steps.do: Still on midwinter, check **Restaurants** in **Filter:**. Confirm **Tundra Tacos** (or **Eurasia Pizza Pizza**) is missing, then enable **Include closed restaurants** and find it.
steps.expect: The closed restaurant marker appears only after **Include closed restaurants** is on (and **Restaurants** is checked).

steps.name: Include closed gift shops
steps.do: Check **Gift Shops** in **Filter:**. Confirm **Twiga Market** (or **Courtyard Kiosk**) is missing on midwinter, enable **Include closed gift shops**, then disable it.
steps.expect: The closed gift shop appears with the include toggle on, and hides when it is off.

steps.name: Include closed attractions
steps.do: Set Specific Map to early October. Check **Attractions** in **Filter:**. Confirm **Splash Island** is missing, enable **Include closed attractions**, find it, then disable the toggle.
steps.expect: Closed **Splash Island** appears with the include toggle on, and hides when it is off.

steps.name: Banner readability
steps.do: With an include toggle that shows banners or closed/off-display cues, read that text.
steps.expect: Wording is readable; layout is not fully broken.

steps.name: Reset toggles
steps.expect: Map matches default inclusion (closed/off-display extras gone).
